text: Our work on [CASSI reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.16690) was accepted to **NeurIPS 2025**.
Our work on [Diffusion Model](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.09365) was accepted to **ICIP 2025**, we also wrote a tutorial for [diffusion model](/blogs/thoughts/diffusion-models/) (updating).
Our work on [Intrinsic Image Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.09352) was accepted to **ICME 2025**.

Our work on [Snapshot NeRF](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2024/papers/Li_SCINeRF_Neural_Radiance_Fields_from_a_Snapshot_Compressive_Image_CVPR_2024_paper.pdf) was accepted to **CVPR 2024** as **Highlight** paper.
Our work on [CACTI for laser processing](https://www.light-am.com/article/doi/10.37188/lam.2024.029) was accepted to **Light: Advanced Manufacturing**.
Our work on [Super-resolution Fluorescence Imaging](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/content/articlelanding/2023/cc/d2cc06707b) was accepted to **Chemical Communications**.
Our work on [Fluorescence Imaging through Scattering Media](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0143816622004432) was accepted to **Optics and Lasers in Engineering**.
Our news & reviews work on [Optical Coherence Tomography](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41377-022-00981-8) was published in **Light: Science & Applications**.
